description: Load Cardamom guidance for associated checkouts.

hooks.command: command -v card >/dev/null 2>&1 && card hook context 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.commandWindows: cmd.exe /d /s /c "where card >nul 2>nul && card hook context 2>nul || exit /b 0"
